goal: Tell heavy from light by feel and on a balance (the heavier pan goes down), see that size does not tell weight, and put three things in order from the lightest.
cover: Beaver stands proudly on his small log raft floating on a sunny brook, Bear sits in the middle of the raft so it dips into the water, and Bunny on the bank holds a red balloon and points at the raft, laughing; a watermelon and a pot wait on the grass.
